author: Vibee0
name: Zen Video Backdrop
description: Plays looping videos from a local folder behind the entire Zen UI. Mirrors Bonjourr's video background settings (frequency, fit, zoom, brightness, blur, fade, playback rate, mute) so you can use Bonjourr/Nebula on top without them having to play any video themselves.

js/zen-video-backdrop.uc.js.name: Backdrop engine
js/zen-video-backdrop.uc.js.description: Scans the configured folder, rotates videos, and injects an HTML <video> element behind the Zen UI.
